socal-1998.notes: Source 1 copy is the 2007-era series front page (belongs to socal-2007); its Hall of Champions table links 1998-99 standings and details.

sources.evidence: The copy is the series front page announcing the 2007 contest of 10-Nov-2007 at Riverside Community College, not the 1998 contest.
Page headed '1998-99 Southern California Regional Programming Contest Detailed Results' gives 29 teams, each with a six-line per-problem block.
Table 'Final Scores for the 1998/1999 Southern California Regional' of 29 ranked teams with Solved, Penalties and Score and no per-problem columns.
Baylor page titled 'Contest Standings as of Fri Nov 20 17:25:05 EST 1998' headed '1998/1999 Southern California Regional Contest Official Results', 29 ranked teams.
